items.question: CurecordAI kya hai aur yeh kaise kaam karta hai?
items.answer: CurecordAI Pakistan mein patients aur families ke liye ek AI-powered personal health record app hai. Aap koi bhi medical document upload karte hain, jaise prescriptions, lab reports aur discharge summaries. AI document ko parhta hai, medications, diagnoses aur lab results nikaalta hai, aur sab kuch har family member ke liye ek searchable health vault mein organize kar deta hai.

items.question: Kya CurecordAI Android aur iOS par available hai?
items.answer: Ji haan. CurecordAI Google Play par Android app, Apple App Store par iOS app, aur ek website ke tor par available hai jo aap kisi bhi browser mein use kar sakte hain.

items.question: Kya main CurecordAI ko WhatsApp par use kar sakta hoon?
items.answer: Ji haan. CurecordAI ka apna WhatsApp AI agent hai. Aap koi alag app download kiye baghair seedha WhatsApp ke zariye documents upload kar sakte hain aur health se mutalliq sawalat pooch sakte hain.

items.question: Health sawalat ke liye CurecordAI aur ChatGPT mein kya farq hai?
items.answer: ChatGPT sirf generic jawabat de sakta hai kyunke uske paas aap ke personal medical records tak rasai nahi hoti. CurecordAI har sawal ka jawab aap ki apni upload ki hui health history ki bunyad par deta hai, isliye jawabat aap ki asal diagnoses, medications aur lab results ke mutabiq hote hain.

items.question: Kya main apni puri family ke records manage kar sakta hoon?
items.answer: Ji haan. Aap apne parents, spouse aur bachon jaisay family members ko apne account mein add kar sakte hain aur har fard ki medical history ko ek hi family vault ke tehat alag alag organize rakh sakte hain.

items.question: Main apne records kisi doctor ke sath kaise share karoon?
items.answer: Share with Doctor screen kholein, choose karein ke kya aur kitni dair ke liye share karna hai, aur CurecordAI ek secure QR code ya link generate kar deta hai. Doctor usay scan karta hai ya link kholta hai aur foran aap ki organized history dekh leta hai, unki taraf se kisi account ki zaroorat nahi.

items.question: Main kis qisam ke documents upload kar sakta hoon?
items.answer: Aap prescriptions, medical reports, X-rays aur lab results upload kar sakte hain. Har type khud-ba-khud aap ke health vault mein apne folder mein file ho jaata hai.

items.question: Kya CurecordAI Urdu support karta hai?
items.answer: Ji haan. AI health assistant aap ke medical documents ko asaan Urdu ya English mein samjhata hai, taake lab results aur doctor ke notes us zaban mein samajh aayein jisme aap sab se zyada asaani mehsoos karte hain.

items.question: Kya mera health data private aur secure hai?
items.answer: Ji haan. Aap ke documents securely store kiye jaate hain aur sirf aap aur un logon ko accessible hote hain jinhein aap khud share karne ka intekhab karte hain. CurecordAI kabhi bhi aap ka health data bechta ya zahir nahi karta. Mukammal details ke liye hamari Privacy Policy dekhein.

items.question: Kya CurecordAI use karna free hai?
items.answer: Ji haan, CurecordAI mukammal taur par free hai - including records upload karna, AI assistant, doctor ke sath sharing, aur family members add karna. Koi paid plan nahi hai.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: CurecordAI ki privacy policy parhein aur jaanein ke hum aapki family ke health records aur zaati maloomat ko kaise jama, mehfooz aur protect karte hain.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Aakhri baar July 2026 mein update kiya gaya. Ye policy batati hai ke CurecordAI aapki maloomat kaise jama karta, istemal karta aur mehfooz rakhta hai.

sections.title: Hum kaunsi maloomat jama karte hain
sections.body: Account banate waqt aap jo maloomat faraham karte hain wo hum jama karte hain, jin mein aapka naam, phone number ya email, aur profile ki tafseelat shamil hain. Is ke ilawa hum wo medical documents bhi mehfooz karte hain jo aap upload karte hain, jaise prescriptions, lab reports aur discharge summaries, aur aapke banaye gaye family member profiles.

sections.title: Hum aapki maloomat kaise istemal karte hain
sections.body: Hum aapki maloomat aapke upload kiye gaye documents organize karne, AI health assistant ko aapke apne records ki bunyad par jawab dene ke qabil banane, aur aapke select kiye gaye doctors ke sath secure sharing ke liye istemal karte hain. Hum aapka health data doosre users ke liye models train karne ke liye istemal nahi karte, aur na hi aapka data kisi third party ko bechte hain.

sections.title: Aapka data kaise store hota hai
sections.body: Documents encrypted cloud storage mein mehfooz kiye jate hain. Hamare database mein sirf har file ka reference rakha jata hai - file khud zaroorat ke waqt banne wale short-lived secure links ke zariye dikhayi jati hai. Aapke account tak rasai ke liye authentication zaroori hai, aur hassas actions ka security audit ke liye record rakha jata hai.

sections.title: Aapke records ki sharing
sections.body: Jab tak aap khud "Share with Doctor" screen se koi share link ya QR code na banayein, aapke records kisi ko nazar nahi aate. Kya share hoga aur kitni der ke liye, ye ikhtiyar aapke paas hai, aur aap kisi bhi waqt access khatam kar sakte hain.

sections.title: Family member ka data
sections.body: Jab aap kisi family member ki profile add karte hain to us shakhs ke records aapke account ke tehat sambhale jate hain. Us ki taraf se health maloomat sambhalne ka munasib ikhtiyar rakhna aapki zimmedari hai, maslan kisi na-baaligh bache ya zair-e-kafalat walid ke liye.

sections.title: Aapke huqooq
sections.body: Aap kisi bhi waqt apni Profile aur Settings se apna account aur us se mutalliq data dekh, update ya delete kar sakte hain. Aap hamari support team se raabta kar ke apne data ka mukammal export ya deletion ki darkhwast bhi kar sakte hain.

sections.title: Is policy mein tabdeeliyan
sections.body: Hum waqtan fawaqtan is privacy policy ko update kar sakte hain. Ahem tabdeeliyan nafiz hone se pehle app ke zariye ya email par batayi jayengi.

sections.title: Hum se raabta karein
sections.body: Agar is privacy policy ya aapke data ke istemal se mutalliq koi sawal ho to humein support@curecordai.com par raabta karein.
